exact_or_approximate: Exact metric search in the mathematical distance model
construction_stages: Compute vantage distances; order and partition at medians/cutoffs; record query metadata; recursively build children.
numeric_contract: Mathematical metric values; no explicit directed FP64 rounding contract established.
nearest_overlap: VP child shells use min/max build distances; MVP medians and selected stored PATH distances support later pruning.
key_difference: No joint unchanged-native-FP32 ordering plus separately rounded FP64 certificate demonstrated.
material_caveat: NO refit describes the published construction recipe, not a measured elimination against GTSPP. MVP persistent PATH arrays are not ephemeral sidecars.
locators: PDF p3, Section 3.3 pp10–11; Section 4.2 pp14–16

exact_or_approximate: Exact range search in the mathematical metric model
construction_stages: Select split points; assign objects to nearest split point; form cross-region min/max distance ranges; recurse.
numeric_contract: Mathematical min/max ranges; directed floating-point enclosure not specified.
nearest_overlap: Construction expressly reuses within-node distances for query-pruning ranges; no later coordinate-distance certification stage is in the simplified recipe.
key_difference: Multi-center Voronoi membership is not native GTS equal-cardinality ordering; no dual arithmetic producer contract.
material_caveat: The paper establishes algorithmic reuse, not exact source arithmetic or one-kernel GPU fusion.
locators: Section 4.1 and preceding motivation, PDF p6 (printed p579)

exact_or_approximate: Exact-search intent under a caller-supplied metric; floating-point safety depends on that callback
construction_stages: GreedyKCenters fills a double matrix; argmin assigns members; the same matrix updates radii and cross-region ranges; recurse.
numeric_contract: double callback distances with ordinary comparisons/min/max, not outward-directed interval pairs.
nearest_overlap: A concrete producer/consumer control: dists(j,i) serves split decisions and persistent pruning metadata without another distance callback for bounds.
key_difference: No FP32 legacy-order/FP64 sidecar pair. Matrix is local to split, but remains alive through child recursion: not proven one-level peak scratch.
material_caveat: NO separate refit is scoped to this split flow. Parent data capacity transfers to local tmp; both tmp and dists remain alive through child recursion and are destroyed when split returns.

exact_or_approximate: Exact metric-search intent; optional compressed pivot metadata is discussed separately
construction_stages: Choose lifetime-fixed pivots; insertion updates ancestor hyper-rings and leaf pivot distances; split unions child intervals or leaf distances.
numeric_contract: Hyper-ring intervals are mathematical distance ranges, not an explicitly outward-rounded arithmetic interval evaluation.
nearest_overlap: Already-computed pivot distances and child ranges become pruning metadata during insert/split without a described post-build object-distance certification sweep.
key_difference: Global pivots and persistent PD/HR metadata differ from GTS level-specific scoring and one-level sidecar.
material_caveat: This checked source describes insertion/splitting, not a dedicated PM-tree bulk loader. Do not relabel hyper-rings as directed FP64 certificates.

construction_stages: Sample and cluster; recursively build subtrees and supertree; redistribute/rebalance; attach subtrees; update upper-region radii.
numeric_contract: Mathematical metric distances and covering radii; floating-point enclosure unspecified.
nearest_overlap: Previous-level root distances and sample distances prune later construction calculations; covering metadata is part of assembly.
key_difference: The pseudocode explicitly retains an upper-region radius-update step, so it does not establish elimination of all bound finalization.
material_caveat: Do not promote reuse for construction decisions into proof that every bound reuses the same scored pairs or that no additional distances are evaluated.

construction_stages: Insert and split; MST splits weighted object graph and selects representatives; optional Slim-down relocates objects and corrects radii.
numeric_contract: Mathematical representative distances and radii; interval arithmetic unspecified.
nearest_overlap: Split graph distances and representative/radius selection are closely coupled; query bounds are maintained as index metadata.
key_difference: Slim-down is an explicit post-construction overlap optimization that changes membership, not GTSPP numeric certification.
material_caveat: The manuscript does not fix distance-matrix storage/reuse semantics for all bounds; no blanket separate-refit-removal claim.
locators: Sections 3–4 pp3–5; Section 6 pp8–9, 16-page author version

exact_or_approximate: Geometric acceleration; no approximate-neighbor quality target
construction_stages: Morton keys; sort; construct radix topology; then assign internal AABBs by leaf-to-root parallel propagation with atomic arrival counters.
numeric_contract: Geometric AABB union; directed FP64 metric certificate not specified.
nearest_overlap: Topology and bounds belong to the build pipeline, and propagation consumes recorded parent pointers.
key_difference: Bounding-box propagation remains a distinct post-topology step; the single-kernel claim concerns radix topology, not topology plus all bounds.
material_caveat: Do not call a separate bottom-up bounding pass eliminated, nor equate AABB unions with D960 pivot/object arithmetic.
locators: Section 4, PDF p4; GPU implementation paragraph preceding it

exact_or_approximate: Acceleration and kNN application; finite-rounding guarantee not established
construction_stages: BFS large/small-node stages; triangle AABB chunk and segmented reductions; split/clip; output layout. Photon version uses sorted coordinate extrema.
numeric_contract: Spatial bounds; explicit directed interval certification not established.
nearest_overlap: Bounds are computed during level build; the photon variant obtains tight large-node boxes from maintained sorted coordinates.
key_difference: Several GPU passes and output reordering remain; this is not a same-distance dual FP32/FP64 metric producer.
material_caveat: NO standalone post-build numeric refit in the described recipe does not mean bounds need no passes. Primary PDF read via web; local download unavailable.

construction_stages: Sort by rectangle centers; tile and pack leaves; enclosing node rectangles provide the input metadata at the next level.
numeric_contract: Bounding rectangles of input rectangles; no directed metric interval contract.
nearest_overlap: Packed groups immediately have bounding metadata; higher-level packing operates on those node rectangles.
key_difference: Spatial rectangle union, not high-dimensional metric scoring or nominal-safe arithmetic separation.
material_caveat: NO independent numeric refit is scoped to the packing description. Archival NASA report has 34 PDF pages including front matter/blanks, not the shorter conference pagination.

exact_or_approximate: Conservative ray/box traversal; not metric-neighbor indexing
construction_stages: Analyze traversal error; pad inverse direction or exit distance. Construction-time bounding-box padding is evaluated as an alternative.
numeric_contract: Conservative traversal error control, primarily FP32; not a dual metric-distance interval producer.
nearest_overlap: Proves safe pruning needs a numeric contract, and considers bounds padded during construction.
key_difference: Padding depends on admissible ray origins; the preferred controls are traversal-side, not same-pair build/refit fusion.
material_caveat: Generic robustness and construction padding are prior art, but this work neither specifies GTSPP bit-exact lo/hi nor an independent refit to remove.
locators: Sections 2–3; Section 6 PDF pp13–14; Section 7 p16

exact_or_approximate: Exact predicates with potentially inexact geometric constructions
construction_stages: Wrap kernel predicates in interval filters and exact fallback; underlying CK constructions remain the same.
numeric_contract: Interval-filtered/exact predicates alongside unchanged, not necessarily exact CK constructions.
nearest_overlap: Separate nominal construction and certified decision arithmetic is already a general numerical design.
key_difference: No metric tree child-bound producer, shared D960 traversal, or post-build refit elimination is established.
material_caveat: This is a numerical control only. Exact predicates can affect decisions; retaining CK constructions does not prove unchanged legacy tree ordering.

index_type: GPU arithmetic API, not an index
exact_or_approximate: Directed rounding primitives, not an exact-search algorithm
construction_stages: Device double add/subtract/multiply/square-root expose explicit round-down and round-up variants.
numeric_contract: Directed FP64 operation semantics; a correct interval expression must still be composed and validated.
nearest_overlap: Outward-directed arithmetic on GPU is an existing capability, not the proposed algorithmic novelty.
key_difference: No topology, ownership, coordinate-load sharing, or tree-bound propagation recipe.
material_caveat: YES is arithmetic capability only, not a published tree certificate. CUDA 13.1 reference is a fixed documentation control, not a GPU/runtime verification this round.
